goal: Analysis AD-22 and the Owner decision of 2026-11-01: the code default model routes keep the same models but call them through OpenRouter (openai/gpt-5.4, openai/gpt-5.4-mini, anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.6, google/gemini-3.5-flash, openrouter/free, openrouter/auto; ids checked against the public OpenRouter model list on 2026-11-01). Admin AI Studio offers only OpenRouter in its provider choices and cards, keeps showing an older non-OpenRouter route as it is so it is never changed silently, and its feature defaults and OpenRouter model list match the server. The canonical model-routing.json and the generated seed follow for daily, persona chat, council and tarot; the astrology_report route keeps its configured model, which the Owner decides separately.
successCriteria: Code default routes for daily, persona chat, council, tarot and astrology report use provider openrouter.
Admin provider choices show OpenRouter, plus the current provider of an older route.
Admin defaults match the server defaults.
untouchedSurfaces: No database model route rows are changed; an active route on the database still wins.
No secret is read or set. Deploying the AI functions waits for Owner approval.

impact.backendContract: Default routes call OpenRouter with provider-prefixed model ids.

impact.privacySafety: Requests go through OpenRouter instead of the providers directly; the persona chat primary is unchanged (openrouter/free).
impact.rollback: Revert the commit on the PR branch.
impact.agentHandoff: The delivery agent owns only the writeScope, runs validation, commits and pushes to the PR branch without merging or deploying.

canonicalContracts: Owner decision 2026-11-01: call the same models through OpenRouter; Admin shows OpenRouter only.
